KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   B. Use insults to “practise” upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to upatiwa kadi za nambari 51-100.

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

3. When practising Maagano, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Maagano.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Maagano.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Maagano.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Maagano.

4. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. nene
   B. pana
   C. fupi
   D. zito

5. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.

6. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. kitoto
   B. mitoto
   C. watoto
   D. mato

7. When practising nyakati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to nyakati.
   B. Copy random text without understanding nyakati.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for nyakati.
   D. Use insults to “practise” nyakati.

8. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.

9. When practising Usalama, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Usalama.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Usalama.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Usalama.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Usalama.

10. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   B. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.
   C. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   D. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain -ake na -ao) and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain miezi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
